# ai-budget-planner-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: ai-budget-planner. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/ai-budget-planner

toolsPreview.name: create_budget
toolsPreview.description: Create a monthly LLM budget allocation for a team or department

toolsPreview.name: get_budget
toolsPreview.description: Get current utilisation, spend breakdown by provider, and alert status for a budget

toolsPreview.name: get_budget_alerts
toolsPreview.description: List all threshold alerts triggered for a budget (50%, 75%, 90%, 100%)

toolsPreview.name: weekly_report
toolsPreview.description: Get a 7-day LLM spend digest broken down by department and provider

toolsPreview.name: department_report
toolsPreview.description: Get month-to-date spend, utilisation, and alert status per department

toolsPreview.name: list_providers
toolsPreview.description: List supported LLM providers, their models, and blended cost estimates per 1M tokens
